about: Hawthorne & Vesper, PLLC works from Court Street downtown, a block from the courthouse, and names three attorneys. It is the only firm in this ranking whose site passes Core Web Vitals, at 99 out of 100 with a largest contentful paint of 1.7 seconds, in a market whose average score is 62 and where no other firm passes.

43 reviews at 3.7. It is one of five firms here to name a bar association it belongs to, the state and American bar associations in its case. It explains three stages of a matrimonial case and one route through one, and it publishes no fee of any kind.
